newsitem.title: TURKEY: Syria, Iran, Iraq forces near Kurd enclave-agency.
newsitem.headline: Syria, Iran, Iraq forces near Kurd enclave-agency.

text.p: Turkey's state-run Anatolian news agency said on Wednesday that Syrian, Iraqi and Iranian troops had build up near the borders of a Kurdish enclave in northern Iraq where Turkish troops are fighting Kurdish rebels.

"Syria, the country which gives the biggest support to the (Kurdistan Workers Party) separatist organisation, has built up troops at the northern Iraq border using the excuse of a military exercise," Anatolian quoted unnamed sources as saying.

It said Iran and Iraq had also built up forces around the Kurdish-controlled territory in northern Iraq. Anatolian accused the three countries of building up troops in an effort to aid fleeing PKK rebels.
More than 10,000 Turkish troops last week began a major cross-border operation into the region in pursuit of the guerrillas. Turkey has closed the area to journalists.
The incursion has drawn criticism from Ankara's Western allies, the United Nations and countries in the region.
